scope.summary: Prove the preserved v02.201 professional Tailor lifecycle without Python, cloud services or mandatory Blender/FBX success; BodyKit-v2 cinematic completion is extended by MT-842.
acceptance_criteria: A no-context model completes representative professional workflows through backend only and GUI only using the built-in UserManual, exact commands/ids, and structured state; outputs and receipts are equivalent.

Multiple agents edit unrelated Cloth/BodyKit entities concurrently, conflict on one entity, recover from stale state, cancellation, device loss, DCC hang, partial artifact, app restart, and retry-failed-only without data loss, focus steal, or authority drift.

Every required vendor capability and professional visual/metric artifact is directly inspected against pinned references; parity claim remains unavailable until the independent validator later accepts the implemented evidence.

The proof traverses the complete 13.36 [TAI-GATE-004..005] workflow through exact 13.34 [TAI-UX-001] native surface families: create/recover project, Cloth pattern/sewing/arrangement/simulation/fabric/repair, BodyKit body/anatomy/pose/contact, interlink/mix, materials/groom, shared render/AOV queue, publish/DCC, optional pillar outages, diagnostics, parallel conflict, and recovery.

Argus/AccessKit proves exact surface and dynamic entity ids plus empty/loading/populated/preview/conflict/failure/recovery/success states, accessibility, responsive layout, backend receipt agreement, and renderer-console cleanliness; the reviewer directly opens the selected captures and compares them with declared references rather than accepting snapshot metadata.

Manual-only proof starts with no conversation context and uses the exact task-specific Tailor UserManual entry to complete both GUI-only and backend-only routes, diagnose injected failures, recover, and confirm equivalent commands, authority versions, receipts, artifacts, Flight Recorder projection, and visible success state.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-781 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, action, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.

Applicable blank, loading, populated, stale/conflict, cancelled, failed, retry, permission, keyboard/focus, narrow/4K/DPI, overlap/clipping, and no-focus-steal states are covered by the registry-derived Argus matrix.

The active TailorInterchangeProfile or runtime capability row records exact direction, versions, hashes, supported payloads, losses, unsupported cases, privacy behavior, artifacts and qualification receipts before the action is exposed.

Proof includes successful canonical Rust behavior plus one missing/removed-adapter or unsupported-direction case and demonstrates no partial authority mutation, silent fallback, data loss or false qualification.

The product path is Rust-owned, local and offline: Python/PyTorch, generated executable scripts, cloud services, implicit network access and runtime downloads are prohibited; optional adapters are pinned and removable.
scope.risk_if_missed: Independent feature tests can pass while the real production lifecycle, recovery, manual, parallel-agent, or parity claim fails.

surfaces: Tailor project and Cloth authoring surface family
Tailor BodyKit creator, face, genitals, rig, and content surface family
Tailor material, shader, groom, and render surface family
Tailor DCC, diagnostics, capabilities, and help surface family

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > DCC parity and qualification

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Independent feature tests can pass while the real production lifecycle, recovery, manual, parallel-agent, or parity claim fails.
GUI, backend, agent, replay, and manual projections may drift if they do not consume the same typed authority.
minimum_controls: One typed owner and exact stable ids are required.
Negative, concurrent, cancellation, recovery, and no-context proofs are required where applicable.
No validator PASS/FAIL is inferred from this pre-activation contract.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.

Use authenticated SurrealDB record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; administrative/root credentials and UI filtering are never the security boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite access paths are forbidden.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
